messages:
maria_cs: Quick ask  we should send a short proactive status to six priority accounts about this morning's ingest hiccup. Draft below for edits. @kevin_success_mgr @jordan_se @liz_product

kevin_success_mgr: Keep it concise. Add a clear line about a one-time billing credit and note how it will appear on the invoice.

jordan_se: TL;DR ops: at ~12:10 UTC we observed ingest queue growth on the shared path. At 12:32 UTC we flipped affected tenants to a warm dedicated pool which cleared the backlog. Backfill is running; you may see slightly higher p99 latency (~15-20%) while backfill completes.

jordan_se: Ops command for CS if customers ask:
```
# enable tenant fallback routing
curl -X POST https://internal-api/tenants/enable-fallback \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"<TENANT>","fallback":"dedicated_pool"}'
```

nick_onboarding: I can own scheduling the enablement offers. Propose two windows: Tue 09:00-11:00 PT and Wed 13:00-15:00 PT. I'll DM each contact after the email goes out.

liz_product: Add an FAQ bullet: "Will this change data residency? No  routing remains within your configured region." Also recommend a 3-question feedback form after enablement. I'll draft it.

ops_lead: Verified fallback is KV-cache compatible for these tenants; no data loss risk. Monitoring continues.

srebot: Incident 6129989000  Embedded ingestion throughput degraded. Mitigation: regional fallback active. Status: monitoring.

maria_cs: Draft email to customers (sending from cs@redwood):
"Hi <CustomerName>,

Were reaching out with a brief status update about a degradation in embeddings ingestion observed from ~12:10 UTC today. To restore throughput we temporarily routed affected tenants to dedicated warm capacity; this resolved the backlog but may cause slightly higher latency for some requests while backfill completes.

What were doing:
- Applied regional fallback to dedicated capacity (completed).
- Running targeted retries/backfill to clear queued items (in progress).
- Investigating root cause; an RCA will be shared within 72 hours.

Billing: We will apply a one-time billing credit to offset measurable impact during the affected period. Your CS rep will follow up with details on how the credit will show on your invoice.

Offer: Wed like to offer a complimentary 30-minute enablement session to review ingest best practices and tuning for your workload. Book here: <calendar-link>.

If you need immediate help, reply to this email or open a support ticket and well prioritize.

Thanks for your patience,
The Redwood Customer Success Team"

kevin_success_mgr: Approved. maria_cs please send and cc me.

maria_cs: Sending now. Tasks:
- maria_cs: send emails (now)
- nick_onboarding: schedule enablement + follow-up
- jordan_se/ops_lead: continue RCA and timeline
- liz_product: publish feedback form
- kevin_success_mgr: confirm credit entries with finance

maria_cs: Will post updates here when customers reply. :rocket:
